title: Replay check
description: Output of `scan --replay-check ID --format json`: a stored scan run again with its own targets and settings, compared with the stored result and its provenance stamp.

reproducible.description: The result is the same and the rules are the same.

same_result.description: No host, port, identity or finding changed between the two results.

same_rules.description: Both scans carry a provenance stamp and the stamps are equal.

original_provenance.description: tool, rules, feeds and combined of the stored scan; absent for a scan saved before the stamps existed.

sent_differences.description: Packets (kind and detail) sent a different number of times.
